title: Federal Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2003

sections.shortTitle: Federal Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

FEDERAL PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT)
FEDERAL PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
ORDINANCE III OF 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the Federal
Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1977
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 28th May, 2003]
F.No.2(1)/2003-Pub, dated
28-5-2003.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Federal Public Service
Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Federal Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Amendment of section 7, Ordinance XLV of 1977

FEDERAL PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT)
FEDERAL PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
ORDINANCE III OF 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the Federal
Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1977
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 28th May, 2003]
F.No.2(1)/2003-Pub, dated
28-5-2003.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 7,
Ordinance XLV of 1977.---In the Federal Public Service Commission
Ordinance, 1977 (XLV of 1977), in section 7, to subsection (1), for clause (a)
the following shall be substituted, namely:---
"(a) to
conduct tests and examinations for recruitment of persons to All-Pakistan
Services, the civil services of the Federation and civil posts in connection
with the affairs of the Federation in basic pay scales 16 and above or
equivalent;".
